answer: Rotating sprout-lottery assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable-random draw (commit-reveal beacon) assigns each registered agent a unique plot in a shared orchard; agents must submit work tagged to their plot before the next draw or forfeit standing. An attacker cloning identities gains nothing by precomputing, since plot assignments depend on beacon output unknowable until reveal. To hold N plots, they must run N agents actually producing plot-tagged work each epoch, and missed assignments reveal clones like dead yarrow. The draw also reseeds a vine of reputation weights,
